description: Hand-curated expectations for the recall & service notification escalation. Values are constraints the synthesis must satisfy, not exact outputs.

required_topics.rationale: Problem 1 of the meeting was a proactive recall/service-action notification. Must be picked up.
Problem 2 was owner-scoped (VIS) delivery so notifications don't go to the wrong driver on a shared vehicle account.

forbidden_topics.rationale: Voice-call reminders were explicitly declined in the meeting.
Recall notifications on the infotainment lock screen were explicitly declined.

expected_duplicates.rationale: AD-176 is the in-backlog warranty/service push-notification ticket carrying the SMS fallback scope, explicitly called out in the meeting as the existing work — any new SMS-notification story should be flagged as a duplicate.

expected_constraint_conflicts.rationale: Surfacing a specific defect/recall code in a push notification requires explicit owner consent, verified contact method, and a 7-year audit log per the GDPR/CCPA rules in Section 3 of architecture_constraints.md. Any story that proposes shipping recall-code notifications without those guardrails should be flagged.
